comment: C ref: topten.c topten() (628-926) reading the record file that earlier segments wrote. The recorder build has PERS_IS_UID 1 and PERSMAX 3 (config.h), so every entry shares one uid and the per-person limit counts entries of the same role whatever the name. Segments 0-2: three dwarvish Archeologists dig down and quit with 150, 150 and 100 points; the tie keeps the earlier entry first. Segment 3: a 50-point Archeologist meets the limit at rank 3 and prints "You didn't beat your previous score of 100 points.", the old entry in bold and its own unranked line. Segment 4: a 200-point Archeologist takes rank 1 and the fourth Archeologist entry (100 points) is dropped from the rewritten file. Segment 5: a Valkyrie quits with 0 points (below POINTSMIN, not entered) with scores:2 top/1 around/own, where own matches every entry by uid. Seeds, clocks, names and keys chosen independently.
